title: Mathlib v4.30 source proposition Nat.size_bit
statement: The proposition declared as `Nat.size_bit` in the pinned Mathlib v4.30 source.

formal.statement: ∀ {b : Bool} {n : ℕ}, Nat.bit b n ≠ 0 → (Nat.bit b n).size = n.size.succ

evidence.checker_command: test "$(cargo run -q -p axeyum-lean-kernel --example nat_theorem_inventory -- size_bit 2>/dev/null | grep -Ec '^Nat\.size_bit[[:space:]]')" -ge 1
evidence.notes: `build_nat_prelude` admits `Nat.size_bit` through the trusted `Kernel::add_declaration` gate, declared in the new module `nat_prelude/size_order.rs` (kept separate from `binary.rs`'s dense `Nat.size` definition-plus-boundary set and from `size_extra.rs`'s existing pair, per this project's merge-hazard convention). `nat_theorem_inventory`'s rendered type is `((x0 : Bool) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> ((x2 : ((x2 : Eq.{1} AxNat (AxNat.bit x0 x1) AxNat.zero) -> False)) -> Eq.{1} AxNat (AxNat.size (AxNat.bit x0 x1)) (AxNat.succ (AxNat.size x1)))))`, matching this fact's `formal.statement`. `nat_theorem_inventory` exits non-zero for a name that does not exist, and the `grep -c` count (tested `-ge 1`, not piped into `grep -q`) requires the admitted declaration to actually be printed. notes: Open in Axeyum. The external theorem declaration is prior art, not a locally constructed proof. formal.statement is a BYTE-IDENTICAL quotation of the pinned extractor's pretty-printed type. This row carries the QUOTATION grade, weaker than the 214 nursery-v1 rows, which were re-elaborated as axioms after `import Mathlib` and accepted: a pretty-printed type is not guaranteed to re-parse and this one has not been tried. Preregistered in artifacts/autogenesis/nursery-v2-extension.json, which carries the partition; that manifest, not this file, is the split authority. Screened against the mirror-divergence registry and the statable-here vocabulary before preregistration. Established 2026-09-01 in this ledger by the `nat-size-squarefree` lane: a fresh local construction (`nat_prelude/size_order.rs`), not a transcription of Mathlib's proof. `binary.rs`'s own `declare_size_aux_lt_pow` doc comment states `Nat.size`'s development had no lemma relating `size n` to `size (n/2)` -- this fact and `F:ml430-nat-size-le-size-c4b98f53` are the first two, sharing new fuel-irrelevance machinery (`Nat.size_aux_agree_of_fuel`, `Nat.size_aux_eq_size_of_le`) since `sizeAux` is single-value fuel recursion (unlike `landAux`/`lorAux`/`bitwiseAux`'s two value slots), reusing `ops.rs`'s `agree_by_fuel_induction` directly rather than needing a new combinator. The key step avoiding any case split on `b` or `n`: `half_le_predecessor_of_succ` (`rec_agreement.rs`) at its own `predecessor := pf, k := pf` (`pf := pred (bit b n)`) fed the trivial `le_refl (succ pf)` gives `Le (div (succ pf) 2) pf`, a fact about `pf` alone; transporting along `bit_div_two` and `bit b n = succ pf` turns this directly into the `Le n pf` the fuel-irrelevance corollary needs. Concrete-instance coverage lives in `nat_prelude/size_order_tests.rs`.
